description:
• Coonan Property presents this spacious four-bedroom family home, ideally positioned within the popular Windermere development, just a short walk from Clonsilla Village and train station. 
• Extending to approximately 124 sq.m., the property offers generous and well-proportioned accommodation throughout. 
• Accommodation comprises entrance hallway, guest W.C., living room, kitchen/dining area, four generous bedrooms including a master with ensuite, and family bathroom. 
• Large site with a south-east facing rear garden and a front driveway providing ample off-street parking. 
• Offers excellent potential to extend to the rear and convert the attic space, subject to the necessary planning permission. 
• Ideally positioned overlooking a large green area, providing a safe play area for families with young children. 
• Within walking distance of Clonsilla Village and Clonsilla Train Station, with a good selection of schools, shops and local amenities nearby. 
• Blanchardstown Shopping Centre and Connolly Hospital are within easy reach, while the M3 and M50 provide easy access to the wider Dublin area. 
• Well served by public transport, with regular bus services and Clonsilla and Hansfield train stations both easily accessible.
